name: Stormbringer: Quickdraft and Clearsky Pendant modify Updraft natively (#1064, #2810)
contract: #1064 and #2810 report 'Spell Script / Aura Handler Not Implemented' for two passives that are plain Spell.dbc modifiers on Updraft (570161-570166/802354, SpellFamilyName 22) and its ally-speed sub-spell 704202. #1064: Quickdraft rank 1 (705704) is aura 107 SPELLMOD_DURATION (misc 1) BasePoints 2999 + DieSides 1 = +3000 ms, and aura 108 SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME (misc 19) BasePoints -16 + 1 = -15%, both on class mask (0,256,*) intersecting Updraft's own SpellFamilyFlags dword1 (256|2147483648); rank 2 (707801) carries +6000 ms and -30% the same way. Updraft's effective learned rank at level 80 is 570166 (AscensionTalentReplacementData.h threshold 58). #2810: Clearsky Pendant (705709) is aura 107 SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 (misc 3) BasePoints 24 + 1 = +25, class mask (0,0,512) intersecting 704202's own SpellFamilyFlags dword2 (512), so it adds to 704202's effect0 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED, base 25%). Aura::CalcMaxDuration, AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic and Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers apply SPELLMOD_DURATION/SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME/SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 generically for every spell family, and SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod has no special case for family 22, so no module code is needed. Values are the server's own Player::ApplySpellMod, measured before and after learning on the same actor; percentage ops use a tolerance band since the harness's own rounding for SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME was not independently traced.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle

BASELINE: Updraft rank 6 tick-rate modifier is 0 without Quickdraft

DISCRIMINATING: Quickdraft rank 1 speeds up Updraft's tick rate by ~15%

DISCRIMINATING: Quickdraft rank 2 lengthens Updraft's duration by 6000 ms
DISCRIMINATING: Quickdraft rank 2 speeds up Updraft's tick rate by ~30%
